guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit network build contract - West Herefordshire and Forest of Dean
guard_streams.write_limit: Contract termination and replacement scope are not current parcel-level serviceability or measured performance.

facts.detail: The page was published on 10 April 2024.
It was last updated on 14 April 2026.
FullFibre no longer delivers the original contract.
BDUK and FullFibre mutually agreed to terminate it.
BDUK moved to arrange alternative supplier plans.
A replacement contract change was agreed in April 2026.
Openreach is the replacement delivery route.
West Herefordshire was added to call-off three.
Call-off three already covers other parts of Herefordshire.
The page records an April 2026 update.

guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit network build contract - New Forest
guard_streams.write_limit: Awarded contract maps and anticipated dates are planned procurement scope; they do not prove current orderability or speed.

facts.detail: The New Forest page was published on 13 April 2023.
It was last updated on 23 November 2023.
Wessex Internet is the awarded supplier.
The contract targets around 10,500 premises.
The first premises were anticipated to gain access in 2024.
Residents and businesses can request service only after network build.
The premises list is subject to detailed planning and technical change.
Further premises details are published through BDUK transparency data.
Premises may be outside scope due to existing infrastructure, commercial plans, cost or technical difficulty.
The page references up to £210 million of Project Gigabit voucher funding.

guard_streams.source: UPRN level release user guide and technical note for premises in BDUK plans
guard_streams.write_limit: BDUK's current-view flags, OMR classifications and intervention plans have timing, supplier-response and contract-change limitations; they require exact UPRN and current-service validation.

facts.detail: The data presents BDUK's current view of OMR status, current gigabit connectivity, future plans and BDUK interventions.
The release is not a comprehensive history of premises delivered through all BDUK programmes.
It is designed for technical users, broadband suppliers and local councils.
The premises base uses the relevant AddressBase Premium epoch with postal and demolition filters.
The schema includes White, Grey/Black, Under Review and Unassessed subsidy-control states.
It contains separate Boolean fields for current and future gigabit status.
GIS contract scope distinguishes initial, deferred and in-procurement premises.
BDUK reports both automated and manual assurance checks.
The June 2026 release uses the January 2026 OMR.
Recent connections and suppliers not responding to the OMR can create gaps in current and future flags.
